_comment: Hand-maintained. Authoritative source: https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/gdp/12.x?topic=classification-system-requirements-data-source-support. Keys must exactly match the database_name values in summary.json. udc_notes holds scope, preview support, and SSL support from that page.

IBM Db2.udc_notes: On-premises (Db2 LUW). Sensitive data preview and SSL supported.

IBM Informix.udc_notes: On-premises. Sensitive data preview not supported.

MongoDB.udc_notes: On-premises. Sensitive data preview and SSL supported.

MS SQL Server.udc_notes: On-premises. Sensitive data preview supported. SSL supported.

MySQL.udc_notes: On-premises. Sensitive data preview and SSL supported.

Oracle.udc_notes: On-premises. Sensitive data preview and SSL supported.

PostgreSQL.udc_notes: On-premises. Sensitive data preview and SSL supported.
